Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely accepted “Rovigo, Veneto, Italy” as the director’s place of death based on search snippets (Wikipedia/IMDb) without verifying the full sources or resolving discrepancies. This anchored the investigation on an incorrect location and led to repetitive, non-progressing searches rather than consulting authoritative Italian biographical databases or obituaries. Subsequent results even showed conflicting data (IMDb and others listing Rome), but the Planner failed to direct a robust cross-verification to reconcile the conflict, leading toward the wrong answer instead of the correct “Roma.”
